sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Locality/Region columns: when a separately-installed flag userscript ("More Flags Everywhere" and friends) marks a bare subdivision — a US state, a UK nation — the value moves from "Locality" to "Region" seconds after the table appears. Filters did not follow it: a "Region" filter typed and retyped afterwards still found only the rows that had that value before the move, and even a freshly typed one did, because each row was still being matched against its pre-move text.
A filter that is active when the move happens is now re-applied on its own, so rows stop being listed under a Locality value the move has taken away from them.
Only pages with split Locality/Region columns (events, performances, area listings) and only with such a userscript installed were affected.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: ShowAllEntityData_HELP.txt: the Locality/Region split now states that the move can happen seconds after the table appears and that an active filter is re-applied to the new values.
